    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

import numpy as np, json
def bands(seps,n):
    out=[];cur=0

    rb=bands(srow,H); cb=bands(scol,W)
    res=[[int(D[r][c]) for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]

    return res

def f(D):
    D=np.array(D); H,W=D.shape
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if all(D[i,j]==8 for j in range(W))]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if all(D[i,j]==8 for i in range(H))]
    rb=list(bands(sr,H)); cb=list(bands(sc,W))
    def rib(i): return rb.index(next(b for b in rb if b[0]<=i<=b[1]))
    def cib(j): return cb.index(next(b for b in cb if b[0]<=j<=b[1]))
    m2=[(rib(i),cib(j)) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if int(D[i,j])==2]
    m3=[(rib(i),cib(j)) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if int(D[i,j])==3]
    O=[[int(x) for x in row] for row in D.tolist()]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if int(D[i,j])!=0: continue
            r,c=rib(i),cib(j)
            p2=min(p[0] for p in m2)<=r<=max(p[0] for p in m2) and c==next(iter({p[1] for p in m2}))
            p3=min(p[0] for p in m3)<=r<=max(p[0] for p in m3) and min(p[1] for p in m3)<=c<=max(p[1] for p in m3)
            if p2 and p3: O[i][j]=6
            elif p2: O[i][j]=2
            elif p3: O[i][j]=3
    return O

    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=int(D[i,j])
            if v!=0: continue
            r,c=rib(i),cib(j)
            p2=min(p[0] for p in m2)<=r<=max(p[0] for p in m2) if m2 else False

def solve(D):
    D=np.array(D); H,W=D.shape
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if all(int(D[i][j])==8 for j in range(W))]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if all(int(D[i][j])==8 for i in range(H))]
    def rib(i): return sum(x<i for x in sr)
    def cib(j): return sum(x<j for x in sc)
    m2=[(rib(i),cib(j)) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if int(D[i,j])==2]
    m3=[(rib(i),cib(j)) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if int(D[i,j])==3]
    R0,R1=min(p[0] for p in m2),max(p[0] for p in m2)
    C0,C1=min(p[1] for p in m2),max(p[1] for p in m2)
    r0,r1=min(p[0] for p in m3),max(p[0] for p in m3)
    c0,c1=min(p[1] for p in m3),max(p[1] for p in m3)
    res=[[int(D[i,j]) for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        if i in sr: continue
        for j in range(W):
            if j in sc: continue
            r,c=rib(i),cib(j)
            v2=R0<=r<=R1 and C0<=c<=C1
            v3=r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1
            if v2 and v3: res[i][j]=6
            elif v2: res[i][j]=2
            elif v3: res[i][j]=3
    return res.tolist()
